rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: three.ws is a browser-based 3D AI agent platform that enables loading GLB/glTF avatars, equipping them with AI capabilities, and embedding them as web components. Its MCP server implements the Model Context Protocol over HTTP with JSON-RPC 2.0, providing tools for avatar management, validation, optimization, and search, with OAuth 2.1 authentication. The platform supports on-chain identity via ERC-8004 and is registered in the official MCP Registry.
